title: Microsoft Teams: collaborative meeting notes saved to the meeting organiser's OneDrive
summary: Hold: the storage change and rollout details match Microsoft's notice, but the automation offered for blocking Facilitator is described as unblocking an app in its cited reference. The Facilitator prerequisites also omit required base and Teams licences; the page should flag action now while the automatic rollout is under way.

claims.claim: The cited Loop storage, Loop requirements and Facilitator pages do not describe the new organiser-owned storage rule.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to update guidance and governance processes and review data location and retention policies for organiser-owned storage.
claims.quote: Review any internal guidance or governance processes that assume meeting notes are stored in the OneDrive of the person who starts them, and update those processes to account for organizer-owned storage for newly created non-channel meeting notes.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Retention policies scoped to the note-starter's OneDrive do not cover files created instead in the organiser's OneDrive unless their scope includes that location.
claims.quote: To specify individual OneDrive accounts, see Get a list of all user OneDrive URLs in your organization.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-settings#locations for individual OneDrive scoping and https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-teams-facilitator for retention of Facilitator notes. Add: 'The SharePoint and OneDrive retention page marks Facilitator notes support as preview, while the Facilitator Purview page lists it as supported.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-sharepoint#what's-included-for-retention-and-deletion for that qualification.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A hold or eDiscovery selection scoped to the starter's OneDrive must also reach the organiser's location to cover new organiser-owned notes.
claims.quote: Place a hold on the Exchange mailboxes and OneDrive accounts of people you're investigating in the case.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-hold-create for the location-scoped hold statement.

claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -IsBlocked $true ... Unblocks Bookings app
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api.call with 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked <Boolean>' and add to its note: 'The reference documents a Boolean app-state parameter, but describes both its $true and $false examples as unblocking. Use the documented Teams admin center Allow or Block action for blocking rather than inferring the Boolean value.' This removes the unsupported assertion that the printed $true value blocks. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/update-m365teamsapp.
